objects.name: companies

attrs.doc: Central Index Key - unique SEC identifier for each company
Type of business entity (e.g., Corporation, LLC)
Human-readable description of the SIC code

sources: 表 companies 及其列注释/文档：cik(中央索引键)、name(公司名称)、ein、lei、sic、sic_description、entity_type、owner_org、category、state_of_incorporation、fiscal_year_end、website、former_names、description 等，描述一家注册实体的身份与属性。

objects.remark: 表 companies 及其列注释/文档：cik(中央索引键)、name(公司名称)、ein、lei、sic、sic_description、entity_type、owner_org、category、state_of_incorporation、fiscal_year_end、website、former_names、description 等，描述一家注册实体的身份与属性。
objects.definition: 以法定注册身份存在、可被监管机构登记并持有唯一登记编号的组织实体。
objects.counterExample: 与「公司地址」「公司股票代码」等信息记录相区别：后者是描述公司的附属信息条目，本身不是可独立承担权利义务的组织实体。

objects.definition: 以文本形式记录某一组织实体所在地理位置、并按其用途分类的信息条目。

objects.remark: 表 company_tickers 列：cik、ticker、exchange，记录某公司在某交易所使用的交易代码。

objects.name: filings

attrs.doc: End date of the reporting period

sources: 表 filings 列：id、cik、accession_number、filing_date、report_date、form、file_number、film_number、items、core_type、size、is_xbrl、primary_document、created_at，记录某公司向监管机构提交的一份申报。

objects.remark: 表 filings 列：id、cik、accession_number、filing_date、report_date、form、file_number、film_number、items、core_type、size、is_xbrl、primary_document、created_at，记录某公司向监管机构提交的一份申报。
objects.definition: 由某一组织实体向监管机构提交、具有唯一受理编号并载明表单类型与提交日期的正式文件记录。
objects.counterExample: 与「财务事实」相区别：申报文件是整份提交物，财务事实是从申报中抽取的单个数值条目，二者是整体与部分的关系。

concepts.name: Revenue
concepts.definition: Total revenue recognized by the company during the period.

concepts.name: NetIncome
concepts.definition: Net income (loss) attributable to the company for the period.

concepts.name: OperatingIncome
concepts.definition: Income (loss) from continuing operations before non-operating items.

concepts.name: GrossProfit
concepts.definition: Revenue less cost of goods sold / cost of revenue.

concepts.name: TotalAssets
concepts.definition: Total assets reported on the balance sheet at period end.

concepts.name: CurrentAssets
concepts.definition: Assets expected to be converted to cash within one year.

concepts.name: CurrentLiabilities
concepts.definition: Obligations due within one year.

concepts.name: TotalLiabilities
concepts.definition: Total liabilities reported on the balance sheet.

concepts.name: StockholdersEquity
concepts.definition: Total stockholders' equity attributable to the parent.

concepts.name: LongTermDebt
concepts.definition: Long-term debt obligations outstanding at period end.

concepts.name: CashAndEquivalents
concepts.definition: Cash and cash equivalents held at period end.

concepts.name: OperatingCashFlow
concepts.definition: Net cash provided by (used in) operating activities.

concepts.name: InvestingCashFlow
concepts.definition: Net cash provided by (used in) investing activities.

concepts.name: FinancingCashFlow
concepts.definition: Net cash provided by (used in) financing activities.

concepts.name: CapitalExpenditure
concepts.definition: Cash paid to acquire property, plant and equipment.

concepts.name: ResearchAndDevelopmentExpense
concepts.definition: Research and development expense recognized in the period.

concepts.name: InterestExpense
concepts.definition: Interest expense recognized on debt obligations.

concepts.name: IncomeTaxExpense
concepts.definition: Total income tax expense (benefit) for the period.

concepts.name: EarningsPerShareDiluted
concepts.definition: Diluted earnings per share attributable to common stockholders.

concepts.name: SharesOutstanding
concepts.definition: Number of common shares outstanding at period end.

concepts.name: ShareBasedCompensation
concepts.definition: Non-cash share-based compensation expense.

concepts.name: Goodwill
concepts.definition: Goodwill recognized from acquisitions at period end.

concepts.name: IntangibleAssets
concepts.definition: Intangible assets excluding goodwill at period end.

concepts.name: Inventory
concepts.definition: Inventory balance at period end.

concepts.name: AccountsPayable
concepts.definition: Accounts payable balance at period end.

concepts.name: PropertyPlantAndEquipmentNet
concepts.definition: Net property, plant and equipment at period end.

concepts.name: DepreciationAndAmortization
concepts.definition: Depreciation, depletion and amortization expense.

concepts.name: OperatingLeaseLiability
concepts.definition: Present value of operating lease liabilities.

concepts.name: UnrecognizedTaxBenefits
concepts.definition: Unrecognized tax benefits recorded for uncertain tax positions.

concepts.name: DeferredTaxAssets
concepts.definition: Deferred tax assets recognized at period end.

concepts.name: DeferredTaxLiabilities
concepts.definition: Deferred tax liabilities recognized at period end.

concepts.name: EffectiveTaxRate
concepts.definition: Effective income tax rate on continuing operations.

concepts.name: ForeignExchangeRisk
concepts.definition: Exposure to changes in foreign currency exchange rates.

concepts.name: CommodityPriceRisk
concepts.definition: Exposure to changes in commodity prices.

concepts.name: SegmentReporting
concepts.definition: Number and identity of reportable business segments.

concepts.name: EntityPublicFloat
concepts.definition: Aggregate market value of common equity held by non-affiliates.

concepts.name: CompanyCategory
concepts.definition: Company classification category (e.g., large accelerated filer).

concepts.name: SICIndustry
concepts.definition: Standard Industrial Classification code describing the company's industry.

concepts.name: FilingFormType
concepts.definition: Type of SEC form filed (e.g., 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K).

concepts.name: FilingDate
concepts.definition: Date the filing was submitted to the SEC.

concepts.name: ReportDate
concepts.definition: End date of the reporting period covered by the filing.

concepts.name: FiscalYear
concepts.definition: Fiscal year of the reported financial data.

concepts.name: FiscalPeriod
concepts.definition: Fiscal period (FY, Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4) of the reported data.

concepts.name: Ticker
concepts.definition: Stock ticker symbol for the company.

concepts.name: Exchange
concepts.definition: Stock exchange where the ticker is listed.

concepts.name: StateOfIncorporation
concepts.definition: State where the company is incorporated.

concepts.name: BusinessAddress
concepts.definition: Primary business address of the company.

concepts.name: ForeignLocation
concepts.definition: Whether the company has foreign address locations.

concepts.name: EarningsPerShareBasic
concepts.definition: Basic earnings per share attributable to common shareholders.
concepts.aggregation: latest value per cik per fiscal_year/fiscal_period

concepts.name: WeightedAverageDilutedShares
concepts.definition: Weighted average number of diluted shares outstanding during the period.
concepts.aggregation: latest value per cik per fiscal_year/fiscal_period

concepts.name: RetainedEarnings
concepts.definition: Cumulative retained earnings (accumulated deficit) at period end.
concepts.aggregation: latest value per cik per end_date

concepts.name: OperatingLeaseRightOfUseAsset
concepts.definition: Right-of-use asset recognized for operating leases at period end.
concepts.aggregation: latest value per cik per end_date

concepts.name: ShareRepurchases
concepts.definition: Cash paid to repurchase common stock during the period.

concepts.name: DividendsPerShare
concepts.definition: Dividends declared per common share during the period.
concepts.aggregation: latest value per cik per fiscal_year/fiscal_period

concepts.name: BusinessAcquisitions
concepts.definition: Cash paid to acquire businesses, net of cash acquired, during the period.

concepts.name: DebtIssuance
concepts.definition: Proceeds from issuance of long-term debt during the period.

concepts.name: DebtRepayment
concepts.definition: Cash used to repay long-term debt during the period.

concepts.name: Company

concepts.name: AcquisitionPayments

concepts.aggregation: latest value per cik per fiscal_year/fiscal_period

caveats.statement: financial_facts contains multiple fact_name variants for the same economic concept (e.g., Revenues vs RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax), so filtering on a single fact_name will undercount companies.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT fact_name, COUNT(DISTINCT cik) AS n FROM financial_facts WHERE fact_name IN ('Revenues','RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax','SalesRevenueNet') GROUP BY fact_name ORDER BY n DESC;

caveats.statement: The same fact_name can appear with different units (USD vs USD/shares vs shares), so summing fact_value without filtering unit mixes incompatible measures.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT fact_name, unit, COUNT(*) AS n FROM financial_facts WHERE fact_name IN ('EarningsPerShareDiluted','Revenues','EntityCommonStockSharesOutstanding') GROUP BY fact_name, unit ORDER BY fact_name, n DESC;

caveats.statement: Fiscal periods include both quarterly (Q1-Q4) and annual (FY) values, so summing across all fiscal_period values double-counts annual figures.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT fiscal_period, COUNT(*) AS n FROM financial_facts GROUP BY fiscal_period ORDER BY n DESC;

caveats.statement: The same fact can be reported in multiple filings (10-K and 10-Q) for the same period, so joining without deduplication on accession_number or end_date inflates totals.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT cik, fact_name, fiscal_year, fiscal_period, end_date, COUNT(DISTINCT accession_number) AS n_filings FROM financial_facts WHERE fact_name = 'Assets' GROUP BY cik, fact_name, fiscal_year, fiscal_period, end_date HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT accession_number) > 1 LIMIT 20;

caveats.statement: Some fact_names are only reported by a small subset of companies (e.g., segment or lease-specific facts), so cross-company comparisons on those facts are sparse.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT fact_name, COUNT(DISTINCT cik) AS n_ciks FROM financial_facts GROUP BY fact_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cik) < 20 ORDER BY n_ciks ASC LIMIT 20;

caveats.statement: Companies table has multiple address rows per cik (mailing and business), so joining companies to company_addresses without filtering address_type duplicates company rows.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT cik, COUNT(*) AS n_addresses FROM company_addresses GROUP BY cik HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 LIMIT 20;

caveats.statement: A company can have multiple tickers across exchanges, so joining companies to company_tickers without deduplication multiplies rows.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT cik, COUNT(*) AS n_tickers FROM company_tickers GROUP BY cik HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 LIMIT 20;

caveats.statement: Some financial facts are reported with dimension_segment or dimension_geography populated, so aggregating without filtering dimensions double-counts consolidated totals.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT fact_name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM financial_facts WHERE dimension_segment IS NOT NULL OR dimension_geography IS NOT NULL GROUP BY fact_name ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 20;

caveats.statement: Filing dates and report dates can differ significantly (e.g., 10-K filed months after fiscal year end), so time-series analysis must choose the correct date column.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT cik, form, filing_date, report_date, (julianday(filing_date) - julianday(report_date)) AS days_lag FROM filings WHERE form = '10-K' ORDER BY days_lag DESC LIMIT 20;

caveats.statement: The same financial concept is reported under multiple fact_name values (e.g., NetIncomeLoss vs ProfitLoss, or LongTermDebt vs LongTermDebtNoncurrent), so filtering on a single fact_name undercounts companies.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT fact_name, COUNT(DISTINCT cik) AS n FROM financial_facts WHERE fact_name IN ('NetIncomeLoss','ProfitLoss','LongTermDebt','LongTermDebtNoncurrent') GROUP BY fact_name ORDER BY n DESC;

caveats.statement: Facts are reported for multiple fiscal_period values (FY, Q1-Q4) and multiple end_dates, so summing fact_value without filtering period double-counts annual and quarterly data.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT fiscal_period, COUNT(*) AS n FROM financial_facts GROUP BY fiscal_period ORDER BY n DESC;

caveats.statement: The same fact can appear in multiple filings (10-K, 10-Q, amendments) with different accession_numbers, so joining without deduplication inflates totals.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT cik, fact_name, fiscal_year, fiscal_period, end_date, COUNT(DISTINCT accession_number) AS n_filings FROM financial_facts GROUP BY cik, fact_name, fiscal_year, fiscal_period, end_date HAVING n_filings > 1 LIMIT 20;

caveats.statement: Some fact_value rows are disaggregated by dimension_segment or dimension_geography, so summing them alongside consolidated totals double-counts.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_dimensioned FROM financial_facts WHERE dimension_segment IS NOT NULL OR dimension_geography IS NOT NULL;

caveats.statement: fact_value is stored as text/numeric with mixed units (USD, shares, pure, USD/shares), so aggregating across units produces meaningless numbers.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT unit, COUNT(*) AS n FROM financial_facts GROUP BY unit ORDER BY n DESC;

caveats.statement: Companies may report under different taxonomies (us-gaap vs ifrs-full), so a fact_name filter scoped to us-gaap misses IFRS filers.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT fact_category, COUNT(DISTINCT cik) AS n FROM financial_facts GROUP BY fact_category ORDER BY n DESC;

caveats.statement: A company can have multiple tickers (multiple exchanges or share classes), so joining companies to company_tickers without aggregation duplicates company rows.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT cik, COUNT(*) AS n_tickers FROM company_tickers GROUP BY cik HAVING n_tickers > 1 LIMIT 20;

caveats.statement: fiscal_year and end_date can disagree (e.g., a 52/53-week fiscal calendar or a non-December fiscal_year_end), so grouping by calendar year misattributes periods.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT cik, fiscal_year, end_date FROM financial_facts WHERE fiscal_year IS NOT NULL AND end_date IS NOT NULL AND CAST(SUBSTR(end_date,1,4) AS INTEGER) <> fiscal_year LIMIT 20;

caveats.statement: The same fact_name can be reported with different end_date values for the same fiscal_year/fiscal_period (restatements or comparative periods), so 'latest value' must be chosen by filed_date or end_date.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT cik, fact_name, fiscal_year, fiscal_period, COUNT(DISTINCT end_date) AS n_end_dates FROM financial_facts GROUP BY cik, fact_name, fiscal_year, fiscal_period HAVING n_end_dates > 1 LIMIT 20;

caveats.statement: The same financial concept is reported under multiple fact_name values (e.g., Revenues vs RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax), so filtering on a single fact_name will undercount companies.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT fact_name, COUNT(DISTINCT cik) AS n FROM financial_facts WHERE fact_name IN ('Revenues','RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax','SalesRevenueNet') GROUP BY fact_name ORDER BY n DESC;

caveats.statement: Financial facts include multiple fiscal periods and forms per cik, so summing fact_value without filtering fiscal_period or form_type double-counts annual and quarterly data.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT cik, fiscal_year, fiscal_period, COUNT(*) AS n FROM financial_facts WHERE fact_name = 'Revenues' GROUP BY cik, fiscal_year, fiscal_period HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 LIMIT 10;

caveats.statement: Balance sheet items (Assets, Liabilities, StockholdersEquity) are point-in-time values; summing them across periods produces meaningless totals.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT cik, fact_name, COUNT(DISTINCT end_date) AS n_dates FROM financial_facts WHERE fact_name IN ('Assets','Liabilities','StockholdersEquity') GROUP BY cik, fact_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT end_date) > 1 LIMIT 10;

caveats.statement: Some fact_value rows are null or zero, which can distort ratios and averages if not filtered.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS null_or_zero FROM financial_facts WHERE fact_value IS NULL OR fact_value = 0;

caveats.statement: The same cik can have multiple tickers across exchanges, so joining companies to company_tickers without deduplication multiplies rows.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT cik, COUNT(*) AS n_tickers FROM company_tickers GROUP BY cik HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 LIMIT 10;

caveats.statement: Companies may have both mailing and business addresses, so filtering on address_type is required to avoid duplicate rows per cik.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT cik, COUNT(*) AS n_addr FROM company_addresses GROUP BY cik HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 LIMIT 10;

caveats.statement: Filing dates and report dates can differ significantly; using filing_date for period comparisons misaligns fiscal periods.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT id, filing_date, report_date FROM filings WHERE report_date IS NOT NULL AND filing_date < report_date LIMIT 10;

caveats.statement: Some financial facts are reported only in certain forms (e.g., 10-K vs 10-Q), so filtering by form_type changes which companies are included.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT form_type, COUNT(DISTINCT cik) AS n FROM financial_facts WHERE fact_name = 'Revenues' GROUP BY form_type ORDER BY n DESC;

caveats.statement: Dimension columns (dimension_segment, dimension_geography) can create multiple rows per fact_name and period, inflating totals if not aggregated.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT cik, fact_name, fiscal_year, fiscal_period, COUNT(*) AS n FROM financial_facts WHERE dimension_segment IS NOT NULL OR dimension_geography IS NOT NULL GROUP BY cik, fact_name, fiscal_year, fiscal_period HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 LIMIT 10;

caveats.statement: Companies table contains former_names as a JSON array; string matching on name will miss entities that changed names.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT cik, name, former_names FROM companies WHERE former_names IS NOT NULL AND former_names != '[]' LIMIT 10;

caveats.statement: Financial facts may be reported under multiple fact_name variants for the same economic concept, causing double counting if not filtered.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT fact_name, COUNT(DISTINCT cik) AS cik_count FROM financial_facts WHERE fact_name IN ('Revenues','RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax','SalesRevenueNet') GROUP BY fact_name ORDER BY cik_count DESC;

caveats.statement: The same financial fact may appear for multiple fiscal periods and forms, so latest value per entity per period must be selected to avoid duplication.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT cik, fact_name, fiscal_year, fiscal_period, COUNT(*) AS row_count FROM financial_facts WHERE fact_name = 'Assets' GROUP BY cik, fact_name, fiscal_year, fiscal_period HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 LIMIT 10;

caveats.statement: Some companies report under IFRS or dei categories rather than us-gaap, so filtering only us-gaap may exclude valid entities.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT fact_category, COUNT(DISTINCT cik) AS cik_count FROM financial_facts GROUP BY fact_category ORDER BY cik_count DESC;

caveats.statement: Fiscal year end varies across companies, so comparing fiscal_year values directly may misalign periods.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT fiscal_year_end, COUNT(*) AS company_count FROM companies GROUP BY fiscal_year_end ORDER BY company_count DESC;

caveats.statement: Filing items column may contain multiple item codes concatenated, so exact equality filters can miss relevant filings.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT items, COUNT(*) AS filing_count FROM filings WHERE items IS NOT NULL GROUP BY items ORDER BY filing_count DESC LIMIT 20;

caveats.statement: Some financial facts are reported with dimensions (segment or geography), which if not filtered will inflate totals.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT fact_name, COUNT(*) AS row_count FROM financial_facts WHERE dimension_segment IS NOT NULL OR dimension_geography IS NOT NULL GROUP BY fact_name ORDER BY row_count DESC LIMIT 10;

caveats.statement: EntityPublicFloat and share counts may be reported in different units (USD vs shares), so unit must be checked before aggregation.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT fact_name, unit, COUNT(*) AS row_count FROM financial_facts WHERE fact_name IN ('EntityPublicFloat','EntityCommonStockSharesOutstanding') GROUP BY fact_name, unit ORDER BY row_count DESC;

caveats.statement: Some companies have multiple tickers or exchanges, so joining on ticker alone may duplicate company rows.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT cik, COUNT(*) AS ticker_count FROM company_tickers GROUP BY cik HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 LIMIT 10;

caveats.statement: Former names are stored as JSON arrays, so name-based searches may miss companies that changed names.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT cik, name, former_names FROM companies WHERE former_names IS NOT NULL AND former_names != '[]' LIMIT 10;

caveats.statement: Some filings may lack XBRL data, so financial_facts may not cover all filings for a given company.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT is_xbrl, COUNT(*) AS filing_count FROM filings GROUP BY is_xbrl ORDER BY filing_count DESC;

caveats.statement: The same financial concept is reported under multiple fact_name values (e.g., NetIncomeLoss vs ProfitLoss, StockholdersEquity vs StockholdersEquityIncludingPortionAttributableToNoncontrollingInterest), so filtering on a single fact_name undercounts companies.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT fact_name, COUNT(DISTINCT cik) AS n FROM financial_facts WHERE fact_name IN ('NetIncomeLoss','ProfitLoss','StockholdersEquity','StockholdersEquityIncludingPortionAttributableToNoncontrollingInterest') GROUP BY fact_name;

caveats.statement: Financial facts include both annual (FY) and quarterly (Q1-Q4) periods; mixing them without filtering fiscal_period double-counts or distorts trends.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT fiscal_period, COUNT(*) AS n FROM financial_facts GROUP BY fiscal_period ORDER BY n DESC;

caveats.statement: Facts are reported in multiple units (USD, shares, USD/shares, pure); summing across units produces meaningless totals.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT unit, COUNT(*) AS n FROM financial_facts GROUP BY unit ORDER BY n DESC;

caveats.statement: Facts are reported under multiple taxonomies (us-gaap, ifrs-full, dei); comparing values across categories without filtering fact_category mixes incompatible definitions.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT fact_category, COUNT(*) AS n FROM financial_facts GROUP BY fact_category ORDER BY n DESC;

caveats.statement: The same fact_name can appear multiple times per cik and period due to restatements or amendments, so the latest filed_date must be selected to avoid duplicates.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT cik, fact_name, fiscal_year, fiscal_period, COUNT(*) AS n FROM financial_facts GROUP BY cik, fact_name, fiscal_year, fiscal_period HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 LIMIT 10;

caveats.statement: Segment and geographic dimensions are often NULL for consolidated totals; filtering on dimension_segment IS NOT NULL excludes company-wide figures.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN dimension_segment IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_segment, SUM(CASE WHEN dimension_geography IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_geo FROM financial_facts;

caveats.statement: Some companies report under IFRS (fact_category = 'ifrs-full') and lack us-gaap fact_names, so us-gaap-only filters silently drop them.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cik) AS ifrs_only_ciks FROM financial_facts WHERE fact_category = 'ifrs-full' AND cik NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT cik FROM financial_facts WHERE fact_category = 'us-gaap');

caveats.statement: Company addresses include both mailing and business types; counting rows without filtering address_type inflates location counts.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT address_type, COUNT(*) AS n FROM company_addresses GROUP BY address_type;

caveats.statement: A company may have multiple tickers across exchanges, so joining on ticker without deduplicating by cik multiplies rows.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT cik, COUNT(*) AS n FROM company_tickers GROUP BY cik HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 LIMIT 10;

caveats.statement: Filing form values include amendments (e.g., 10-K/A, 8-K/A) that duplicate the original filing's content; counting all forms double-counts disclosures.

caveats.statement: Some financial facts are reported in different units (e.g., USD vs shares) and mixing them without filtering by unit will produce incorrect aggregations.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT fact_name, unit, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM financial_facts GROUP BY fact_name, unit ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 20;

caveats.statement: Financial facts may include both annual (FY) and quarterly (Q1-Q4) periods; summing across all periods without filtering by fiscal_period will overstate annual figures.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT fiscal_period, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM financial_facts GROUP BY fiscal_period ORDER BY cnt DESC;

caveats.statement: Some companies report under different accounting standards (us-gaap vs ifrs-full), and fact_name values may differ or be missing across standards.

caveats.statement: The same business concept may be recorded under different fact_name values (e.g., NetIncomeLoss vs ProfitLoss), so filtering on a single fact_name may miss entities.

caveats.statement: Some financial facts have NULL or zero values for fact_value, which can skew averages and ratios if not handled.

caveats.statement: Company addresses may have multiple entries per cik (mailing and business), and joining without filtering by address_type will duplicate rows.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT cik, COUNT(*) AS addr_count FROM company_addresses GROUP BY cik HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 LIMIT 10;

caveats.statement: Ticker and exchange data may have multiple entries per cik over time, and using the latest without ordering by date can pick stale tickers.

caveats.statement: Some financial facts are reported with dimensions (segment, geography) and aggregating without considering dimensions will mix consolidated and segment-level values.

caveats.statement: Financial facts are reported at different fiscal_period granularities (FY, Q1-Q4), so mixing periods without filtering will double-count or misalign values.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT fiscal_period, COUNT(*) AS rows FROM financial_facts GROUP BY fiscal_period ORDER BY rows DESC;

caveats.statement: The same fact_name can appear with different units (USD, shares, pure), so summing without filtering unit will produce meaningless totals.

caveats.statement: Facts are disaggregated by dimension_segment and dimension_geography; summing across all rows without filtering dimensions will double-count consolidated totals.

caveats.statement: The same fact can be reported in multiple filings (10-K, 10-Q, amendments), so joining facts to filings without deduplication will duplicate values.

caveats.statement: Some companies report under ifrs-full or dei taxonomies rather than us-gaap, so filtering only on us-gaap will exclude them.

caveats.statement: Not all filings contain XBRL data, so facts may be missing for companies whose filings are not XBRL-tagged.

caveats.statement: Company addresses have both 'mailing' and 'business' address_type rows, so joining without filtering address_type will duplicate company rows.

themes.definition: Analyzes comprehensive income and other comprehensive income items.

themes.name: NoncontrollingInterestAndMinorityInterest
themes.definition: Analyzes noncontrolling interest and minority interest.

themes.name: OperatingExpensesAndOtherIncome
themes.definition: Analyzes operating expenses and other non-operating income/expense.

themes.name: InventoryAndAccountsReceivable
themes.definition: Analyzes inventory and accounts receivable balances.

themes.name: RetainedEarningsAndDividends
themes.definition: Analyzes retained earnings and dividend distributions.

themes.name: OtherAssetsAndLiabilities
themes.definition: Analyzes other noncurrent assets and liabilities.

themes.name: InvestingAndFinancingOtherActivities
themes.definition: Analyzes other investing and financing cash flow activities.

themes.name: FilingAndDisclosureMetadata
themes.definition: Analyzes SEC filing metadata and disclosure characteristics.

themes.name: GeographicAddressAndDomicile
themes.definition: Analyzes company address, domicile, and geographic location.

themes.name: TickerAndExchangeListing
themes.definition: Analyzes ticker symbols and exchange listings.

themes.name: Profitability
themes.definition: How profitable the company is across revenue, gross profit, operating income and net income, and how margins trend over time.

themes.name: RevenueTrend
themes.definition: How total revenue evolves across fiscal years and periods, including growth rates.

themes.name: RegionalPerformance
themes.definition: How performance splits across geographies, including domestic vs foreign pretax income and revenue.

themes.name: CapitalStructure
themes.definition: How the company is financed through debt and equity, including leverage and maturity profile.

themes.name: Liquidity
themes.definition: How much cash and short-term resources the company has to meet near-term obligations.

themes.name: CashFlow
themes.definition: How cash is generated and used across operating, investing and financing activities.

themes.name: TaxPosition
themes.definition: The company's tax expense, deferred tax balances and unrecognized tax benefits.

themes.name: AssetBase
themes.definition: Composition of the company's assets including PP&E, goodwill, intangibles and other noncurrent assets.

themes.name: LeaseObligations
themes.definition: Operating lease liabilities, costs and future minimum payment schedule.

themes.name: ShareBasedCompensationTheme
themes.definition: Share-based compensation expense and stock option plan activity.

themes.name: RegulatoryAndEnvironmentalRisk
themes.definition: Regulatory, environmental and operational risks disclosed by the company, including those tied to hydraulic fracturing services and supply chains.

themes.name: FilingActivity
themes.definition: How frequently and in what form the company files with the SEC, including annual, quarterly and current reports.

derived.name: GrossMargin
derived.definition: Gross profit as a percentage of revenue.

derived.name: OperatingMargin
derived.definition: Operating income as a percentage of revenue.

derived.name: NetMargin
derived.definition: Net income as a percentage of revenue.

derived.name: RevenueGrowth
derived.definition: Year-over-year percentage change in revenue.

derived.name: NetIncomeGrowth
derived.definition: Year-over-year percentage change in net income.

derived.name: ReturnOnAssets
derived.definition: Net income divided by average total assets.

derived.name: ReturnOnEquity
derived.definition: Net income divided by average stockholders' equity.

derived.name: DebtToEquity
derived.definition: Long-term debt divided by stockholders' equity.

derived.name: DebtToAssets
derived.definition: Long-term debt divided by total assets.

derived.name: CurrentRatio
derived.definition: Current assets divided by current liabilities.

derived.name: FreeCashFlow
derived.definition: Operating cash flow less capital expenditures.

derived.name: CashFlowMargin
derived.definition: Operating cash flow as a percentage of revenue.

derived.name: EffectiveTaxRateDerived
derived.definition: Income tax expense divided by pre-tax income.

derived.name: CapexToRevenue
derived.definition: Capital expenditures as a percentage of revenue.

derived.name: R&DToRevenue
derived.definition: Research and development expense as a percentage of revenue.

derived.name: InterestCoverage
derived.definition: Operating income divided by interest expense.

derived.name: AssetTurnover
derived.definition: Revenue divided by average total assets.

derived.name: EquityRatio
derived.definition: Stockholders' equity as a percentage of total assets.

derived.name: WorkingCapital
derived.definition: Current assets less current liabilities.

derived.name: BookValuePerShare
derived.definition: Stockholders' equity divided by shares outstanding.

derived.name: OperatingIncomeGrowth
derived.definition: Year-over-year percentage change in operating income.

derived.name: FreeCashFlowProxy
derived.definition: Operating cash flow minus capital expenditures.

derived.name: GoodwillToAssets
derived.definition: Goodwill as a percentage of total assets.

derived.name: IntangibleToAssets
derived.definition: Intangible assets as a percentage of total assets.

derived.name: SBCToRevenue
derived.definition: Share-based compensation as a percentage of revenue.

derived.name: NetProfitMargin
derived.definition: Net income divided by revenue, expressing bottom-line profitability.

derived.name: RevenueGrowthYoY
derived.definition: Year-over-year percentage change in revenue.

derived.name: NetIncomeGrowthYoY
derived.definition: Year-over-year percentage change in net income.

derived.name: CapitalReturnRatio
derived.definition: Share repurchases divided by operating cash flow.

derived.name: ForeignIncomeShare
derived.definition: Foreign pre-tax income divided by total pre-tax income (domestic plus foreign).

derived.name: AssetCompositionChange
derived.definition: Year-over-year percentage change in total assets.

derived.name: OperatingCashFlowMargin
derived.definition: Operating cash flow divided by revenue.

derived.name: CashToDebt
derived.definition: Cash and equivalents divided by total debt.

derived.name: EBITDA
derived.definition: Operating income plus depreciation and amortization.
aliases: earnings before interest taxes depreciation and amortization
